candidate_grammar: A read-only receiver may validate both files and compare finite counts and totals. It may authorize neither launch, retry nor account mutation unless a unique charge-to-task relation is present in the received bytes. The v0 trial schema contains no such relation.
evaluation: Every valid case returns UnknownAttemptState, preserves both input files byte-for-byte and authorizes no continuation. The totals-only control must match the same seven-unit charge to two distinct task journals, demonstrating that equality of totals cannot be the missing binding.
exit: Stop on the first pin, schema, process, output, mutation, classification, accounting or resource failure. Do not repair, bind, spawn or retry a target task.
objects_and_types: Canonical project-original JSON trial accounts of profile cumulative-trial-v0 and canonical project-original single-writer task journals. Charges are positive bounded integers only; task, purpose, reservation sequence and arithmetic totals remain distinct.
origin: Project-original ChatGPT (OpenAI), Unknown v0.3, submitted through Mingli Yuan's authorized account proxy; not his authorship, review, endorsement or correctness guarantee. No external content is incorporated.
protected: All earlier invalid and charged attempts remain visible and charged
UnknownAttemptState is not a counterexample or permission
Numerical equality is not a task binding
No refund, automatic retry or target process start
No native free, Close, M6 or arithmetic-universality claim
quantifiers: Five fixed receiver cases: two charge-before-reservation gaps with different amounts, two distinct task journals that each equal the same single charge by total, and one task reservation with no trial charge.
question: After the cumulative account is charged but before the task journal records a reservation, can the current v0 account safely determine which task owns the charge and authorize a launch?
